sentences.text: Learned APP Ms. Jirga Jhaveri, waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of respondent No.1 - State of Gujarat.

R/CR.RA/640/2021 ORDER DATED: 30/09/2021 Considering the fact that for the offence under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant is imposed a rigorous imprisonment of three months and fine of Rs.25,000/-, and pursuant to an order passed by the Appellate Court, the applicant is taken into custody on 14.09.2021, pending final disposal of the petition, the applicant is ordered to be released on bail on the terms and conditions that may be imposed by the Trial Court.
Accordingly, the present application stands disposed of.
Rule made absolute to the above extent.
